citations.cited_text: HED (Hierarchical Event Descriptors) is a framework for annotating events in neuroimaging and behavioral data using structured tags drawn from a controlled vocabulary. To annotate an event with HED tags, you assign one or more comma-separated tags from the HED schema to that event, describing what happened using terms like Sensory-event, Visual-presentation, or Agent-action. Tags are typically stored in an events.tsv sidecar file alongside the raw data, following the BIDS specification for tabular event files.
